activity_summary: The Strand was empty and iron-cold, and Somerset House's gate was shut. The walk goes on from here by Fleet Street, Ludgate and Cheapside. The picture is the gate.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Was on the Strand side of the gate.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Was in the same cold, out of the king.

facets.activity: Walked on from the shut gate
